item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over Guangdong during the weekend and next week. It will still be cool in the morning over the region in the next few days. Winds will weaken slightly over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow, and it will be warm during the day. A fresh to strong replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Sunday morning. It will become cloudier over the region in the following couple of days.
